title: Bacon Egg Cheese Cups
creator: Keto Kitchen
sourceTitle: QUICK EGG CUPS WITH BACON AND CHEESE. Carnivore Breakfast Recipe. Keto Egg Muffins.
method: Line muffin cups with bacon.
Crack an egg into each cup and add mozzarella.
Bake until the bacon is cooked and the eggs are set to your preference.

title: Bacon-Wrapped Beef Dogs
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Season the mince with salt and form short sausage-shaped logs.
Wrap each log in bacon.
Bake hot until the beef is cooked and the bacon is browned.

title: Crispy Beef Nuggets
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Shape mince into small flat nuggets.
Dip each piece in dairy, then coat with crushed pork rinds.
Bake until crisp and cooked through.
mealPrep: Freeze cooked nuggets in single portions.

title: Beef & Sausage Meatballs
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Finely chop the sausage and mix with beef and salt.
Form meatballs and sear in an oven-safe pan.
Finish in the oven until cooked through, then rest before serving.
strictNote: Choose sausage with no sugar, starch, flour or plant fillers.

title: 3-Ingredient Carnivore Pancakes
creator: Courtney Luna
method: Whip the egg whites and incorporate gelatin.
Mix yolks with collagen.
Fold the mixtures together gently and pan-cook over medium-low heat until set on both sides.
mealPrep: Best fresh; refrigerate up to 2 days.

title: Egg, Cottage Cheese & Pork-Rind Bread
creator: Courtney Luna
method: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour into a parchment-lined loaf pan.
Bake until browned and set through the centre, then cool completely before slicing.
mealPrep: Slice and freeze; toast from chilled or thawed.

title: Carnivore Smash Burger Tacos
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Blend pork rinds, eggs and cheddar into a tortilla batter and bake thin rounds until firm.
Place a beef ball in a hot pan, top with a tortilla and smash flat.
Cook, flip, add cheese and finish until the beef is cooked.
mealPrep: Prep tortillas and beef separately; assemble when reheating.

title: Carnivore Beef & Cheese Layered Casserole
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Blend pork rinds, mozzarella and eggs, press thin and bake into a firm sheet.
Brown the beef with salt.
Layer pieces of the baked sheet with beef and cheese in a loaf dish, then bake until bubbling and browned.
mealPrep: Fridge and freezer friendly; portion after cooling.
strictNote: The source uses plant-derived taco seasonings; this version omits them.

title: Pork-Rind Chicken-Fried Steak
creator: CarnivorousChef
sourceTitle: Chicken Fried steak for your [Carnivore Diet]
method: Flatten steak between parchment.
Dip in egg, coat with pork-rind crumbs and shallow-fry in animal fat until browned and cooked.
Reduce bone broth, cream and collagen separately for a simple carnivore gravy.
mealPrep: Best fresh; gravy stores separately for 3 days.

title: Stuffed-Crust Chicken Pizza
creator: CarnivorousChef
sourceTitle: Stuffed Crust Buffalo Chicken Carnivore Pizza
method: Blend chicken, mozzarella, pork rinds and egg into a dough.
Press half thin, ring the edge with string cheese, cover with remaining dough and seal.
Bake until lightly browned, add a reduced cream-parmesan sauce and animal-based toppings, then finish in the oven.
strictNote: The source adds hot sauce and garlic; this strict version omits them.

title: Savory Carnivore Donuts
creator: CarnivorousChef
sourceTitle: Donuts for the Carnivore Diet -- Zero Carb Donut Recipe
ingredients: cream cheese or cooked breakfast sausage or ground pork rinds
method: Choose one base: cream cheese, sausage, or pork-rind crumbs.
Blend the chosen base with eggs until smooth.
Fill an oven-safe donut mould and bake until set.
mealPrep: Fridge 3 days; pork-rind and sausage versions freeze well.
strictNote: Omit baking powder, sweetener, colouring and sweet icing for strict carnivore.

title: Chicken-Crust Carnivore Pizza
creator: CarnivorousChef
sourceTitle: Carnivore Pizza (#3) for your Carnivore Diet -- Chicken Crust Recipe
method: Blend chicken, mozzarella, pork rinds and egg into a firm dough.
Cook the crust until browned and dry enough to hold toppings.
Reduce cream and parmesan into a thick sauce, spread over the crust, add mozzarella and prosciutto, then broil until browned.
mealPrep: Freeze cooked slices with parchment between them.

title: Carnivore Fish Sandwich
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Blend chicken, pork rinds, eggs and cream cheese and bake in bun-sized moulds.
Coat cod with egg and pork-rind crumbs and fry in beef tallow.
Assemble with a simple cream-cheese/sour-cream sauce and cheese.
mealPrep: Prep buns and fish separately; re-crisp fish before assembly.
strictNote: The source sauce includes vinegar and seasonings; omit them for strict carnivore.

title: Bacon, Sausage & Egg Breakfast Strata
creator: CarnivorousChef
method: Blend pork rinds and eggs into a thin bread-style base and bake briefly.
Layer the base with cheddar, cooked bacon and sausage.
Pour over an egg-and-dairy custard and bake until set; rest before slicing.
strictNote: Use filler-free sausage and omit plant seasonings/mustard from the source version.
